doc_title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Stock
doc_title_jp: 自己株式の消却に関するお知らせ
summary_en: NSD will cancel 3,000,000 common shares, or 3.9% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock, on October 16, 2026, reducing outstanding shares to 83,000,000.
summary_jp: 300万株を消却し、発行済株式総数（自己株式を除く）に対する割合は3.9％。消却予定日は2026年10月16日。

doc_title_en: Notice Regarding Revision (Increase) of FY2027 March Year-End Dividend Forecast
doc_title_jp: 2027年３月期 期末配当予想の修正（増配）に関するお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: 業績予想の上方修正及び配当性向50％以上、総還元性向70％以上の株主還元基本方針

summary_en: NSD raised its FY2027 March year-end dividend forecast from 97 yen to 100 yen per share, a 4 yen increase from the prior year, reflecting upward revision of full-year earnings guidance and adherence to its capital allocation policy of dividend payout ratio of 50% or more and total shareholder return ratio of 70% or more. The payout ratio is projected at 56.7% and total return ratio at 71.6%.
summary_jp: 2027年3月期の期末配当を1株当たり97円から100円に修正。前期比4円の増配。業績予想の上方修正と配当性向50％以上、総還元性向70％以上という基本方針に基づく。配当性向56.7％、総還元性向71.6％の見込み。
